keep.text: Aap believe nahi karoge ye sun karke ki kal raat jo aap logon ne gaana suna hai full volume pe earphone laga karke, wo aapke kaan ko do saal boodha kar diya hai.
Aur ye main nahi keh raha hoon,
Harvard ke bahut saare professors keh rahe hain,
aur
bahut saare scientists bhi bata rahe hain
ki every time we blast our ears
with high volume,
we go home with older ears.
Yaani ki jitne bhi log parties-warties kar rahe ho na, bahut high volume ka jo gaana sun rahe ho,
aap sab logon ke kaan boodhe ho rahe hain, do do saal.
Kyun ho raha hai? Toh chaliye samajhte hain. Jab extreme sound waves aapke kaanon ke cells ko
padti hain na, toh kaan ke andar ek physical damage ho jaata hai,
DNA mein breaks ho jaate hain.
Aur aapke DNA ke upar ek packaging hai,
epigenome ki.
Epigenome,
protein jo DNA ko wrap karta hai.
Jab DNA break hota hai, toh ye protein DNA ko
chhod karke damage fix karne lagta hai.
Aur jab ye fix karke wapas aate hain, toh saare wapas nahi aa paate hain,
packaging loose reh jaati hai.
Aur yahi hai aging ka fundamental mechanism.
Aur ye sirf loud music se nahi hai. Excessive sun ke jo thymine dimers bante hain,
wo
aapki capillaries ko shrink kar dete hain.
X-rays,
X-rays se jo DNA toot-te hain.
Aap logon ko sunne mein fake lag raha hoga, magar ye 100% sach hai ki aapki body mein roz, har din
bees trillion DNA breaks hote hain,
normal functioning se, sirf aur sirf.
Ye saari cheezein sirf alive rehne ke liye hoti hain.
Aur sabse buri baat pata hai kya hai? Isko aap rok nahi sakte hain, sirf aur sirf slow kar sakte ho.
Jab maine ye science samjhi,
toh standing
desk lagaya apna,
khade hone waala, ye jo yahan par hai na, main jis par baitha hoon,
yahan par main khada hokar bhi kaam kar sakta hoon, easily.
Kabhi bahut zyada shor waala
music nahi suna,
volume limit set ki,
taaki
jo phone mein aap logon ko volume limit aati hai na, usse zyada kabhi tez music nahi suna.
Fasting shuru ki,
aur jiske through mere DNA repair hone lage,
mere
DNA improve hone lage.
Aur ye saari cheezein maine ek protocol mein bana ke rakh di hain.
Toh ye poora ka poora system agar aap logon ko chahiye,
toh comment box mein likh dijiye HEALTH PROTOCOL.
Mera kaam tha science pahunchana,
decision aapka hai. You are watching FitFinfluencer, milte hain
next video mein!
